name: func2str_anonymous
expr: out = [func2str(@(x) x + 1) '|' func2str(@(a,b) a.*b + 1) '|' func2str(@(x) sin(x).^2 + cos(x)) '|' func2str(@() 42) '|' func2str(@(s) [s, ' world']) '|' func2str(@sin) '|' func2str(str2func('@(x) x.^2 - 3')) '|' func2str(@(x) x + cap)];
comment: func2str on anonymous handles returns the reconstructed source with MATLAB-normalized whitespace (bugs/runtime/func2str-anonymous): inter-token whitespace dropped, char/string literals kept verbatim. Joined results (| separated) must match MATLAB R2025b exactly: '@(x)x+1|@(a,b)a.*b+1|@(x)sin(x).^2+cos(x)|@()42|@(s)[s,' world']|sin|@(x)x.^2-3|@(x)x+cap' (note the char literal ' world' keeps its interior space; @sin is a named handle -> bare 'sin'; str2func(func2str(.)) round-trips; the last case CAPTURES cap — on the VM that is a closure cell {handle,capture}, which func2str now unwraps, so captured anon handles work on both engines). out_var=out -> exact text comparison. namespace=runtime.
